title: What If Every Horseshoe Crab Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every horseshoe crab vanished? Your vaccines would lose their safety test.
Their milky-blue blood clots around bacterial toxins, so a test made from it checks vaccines and injected drugs.
About 500,000 crabs are caught each year, and roughly a third of their blood is drained.
These crabs have lived nearly unchanged for more than 400 million years.
Their eggs matter too. Red knots double their weight in two weeks at Delaware Bay feeding on them.
A synthetic test now exists, which is why this is a what if. For now, their blue blood still guards your medicine.

description:
